additional_info.subject: RE: 0427605-DC/Si-D/AE-[MP / R8 170002521] HMI not working CRM:00579001642
additional_info.body:
Hi Basheer,
Thank you for your cooperation during the remote call.
We have checked the 24 Volts supply present on the HMI and also replaced the DPP cable. However, the screen remains black with no backlight, which suggests a potential issue with the HMI itself. Currently, there is no spare HMI available to test by replacement.
We recommend testing with a spare HMI. If the spare HMI works, please proceed with the replacement.
Best Regards,
Sominath Nagalgaon
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
